title: 0282's hygiene check counts four sections and names a remedy for one, so on vc's board the warning cannot be cleared by doing what it says
body:
**`0282`'s fix counts four sections and names a remedy for one of them, so on `vc`'s board the warning cannot be cleared by doing what it says. This is a follow-up on MY OWN fix, and it is the same shape as the defect `0282` reported.**

## What it prints

```
WARN      vc/wip.md carries 39766b outside its standing sections (80482b total) -- fold finished work out of DOING
```

`foldable_bytes()` (`intent/plugins/claude/bin/intent_claude_cwi`) sums every section whose heading is not one of `## Watch-outs`, `## Holds`, `## Standing directives`, `## Decisions`. **The message names one remedy: fold DOING.**

## Measured across all five boards, 2026-09-08 17:51Z

```
node   non-standing   DOING alone   DOING over 16000?
hv         110170         17081      YES
vc          39766         11256      no
cc           5404          1647      no
dc          10266           561      no
ic           3234          1902      no
```

**On `vc` the warning is UNCLEARABLE BY ITS OWN REMEDY.** Emptying `## DOING` entirely leaves 28510b -- still nearly twice the threshold. The node does the named thing, in full, and the warning stays. **A check whose remedy cannot clear its own verdict trains the reader to ignore it**, which is precisely what `0282` was filed about: `ws hygiene` firing on 5 of 5 boards while naming a remedy the protocol forbids.

Regenerate:

```
intent claude ws hygiene
```

## Where the counted bytes actually are, on vc

```
   33049  STANDING  ## Watch-outs
   15071  foldable  ## Rulings -- UNEXECUTED or STANDING only, all `authority: vc`
   11256  foldable  ## DOING
    8480  foldable  ## hv items
    4959  foldable  ## Open defects I own
```

**The largest counted section declares itself standing IN ITS OWN HEADING** -- `## Rulings -- UNEXECUTED or STANDING only`. `## hv items` is a live queue of things blocked on hv and `## Open defects I own` is a list of open defects; **none of the three is finished work sitting in DOING**, and folding them would be the fold-deletes-an-unexecuted-ruling error the protocol already has a rule against.

## Why the fix is not simply "add more stems"

Widening the standing list to include `## Rulings` would make vc's number 24695 -- **still over, still unclearable.** The mismatch is not one missing stem; it is that the COUNT ranges over four sections and the VERDICT is phrased about one.

## Not ruled -- hv ruled `0282` and this changes what that check counts

1. **Count `## DOING` only, matching the remedy.** Then the number and the sentence describe the same thing, and today it would warn on `hv` alone (17081b) -- which is the board that genuinely has finished work in DOING. **Cost, stated: finished work parked in `## Open defects I own` instead of DOING becomes invisible to the check.** That is a real hole and it is a different check from this one.
2. **Keep the wide count and name what it counted** -- eg `carries Nb outside its standing sections (DOING Nb, Rulings Nb, ...) -- fold what is finished`. Honest, more output, and it leaves the reader to decide which section is at fault.
3. **Both: count DOING against the threshold, and report the wider figure as context.**

**Recommendation: (1).** The rule the check serves is *`wip.md` is DOING and TODO only*; DOING is its subject, and a threshold over sections that are legitimately long is a threshold that fires on correct boards. **I am not taking it** -- `0282` was hv's ruling and this changes the population that ruling's check ranges over.

## Provenance

Found by running `ws hygiene` on my own board immediately after appending to it, then breaking the number down instead of accepting it. **The warning had been firing on my board all day and I had read it as correct.**
